entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:1
segments: ¶But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that ye should be written to,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:2
segments: for ye know perfectly well yourselves, that the day of [the] Lord so comes as a thief by night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:3
segments: When they may say, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction comes upon them, as travail upon her that is with child; and they shall in no wise escape.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:4
segments: But *ye*, brethren, are not in darkness, that the day should overtake you as a thief:

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:5
segments: for all *ye* are sons of light and sons of day; we are not of night nor of darkness.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:6
segments: ¶So then do not let us sleep as the rest do, but let us watch and be sober;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:7
segments: for they that sleep sleep by night, and they that drink drink by night;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:8
segments: but *we* being of [the] day, let us be sober, putting on [the] breastplate of faith and love, and as helmet [the] hope of salvation;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:9
segments: because God has not set us for wrath, but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:10
segments: who has died for us, that whether we may be watching or sleep, we may live together with him.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:11
segments: ¶Wherefore encourage one another, and build up each one the other, even as also ye do.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:12
segments: But we beg you, brethren, to know those who labour among you, and take the lead among you in [the] Lord, and admonish you,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:13
segments: and to regard them exceedingly in love on account of their work. Be in peace among yourselves.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:14
segments: But we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, comfort the faint-hearted, sustain the weak, be patient towards all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:15
segments: See that no one render to any evil for evil, but pursue always what is good towards one another and towards all;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:16
segments: ¶rejoice always;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:17
segments: pray unceasingly;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:18
segments: in everything give thanks, for this is [the] will of God in Christ Jesus towards you;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:19
segments: quench not the Spirit;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:20
segments: do not lightly esteem prophecies;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:21
segments: but prove all things, hold fast the right;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:22
segments: hold aloof from every form of wickedness.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:23
segments: ¶Now the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly: and your whole spirit, and soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:24
segments: He [is] faithful who calls you, who will also perform [it].

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:25
segments: Brethren, pray for us.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:26
segments: Greet all the brethren with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:27
segments: I adjure you by the Lord that the letter be read to all the [holy] brethren.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:28
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you.
